spectators.name: Shigeo Kageyama (Mob)
spectators.look: quiet middle-school boy with a neat black bowl haircut, blank half-lidded dot eyes and a flat expressionless mouth, wearing a fully buttoned black high-collar school uniform with gold buttons, black trousers and black shoes
spectators.fallbackLook: quiet short schoolboy with a neat black bowl haircut, blank half-lidded dot eyes and a flat mouth in a fully buttoned black high-collar school uniform with gold buttons and black trousers
spectators.idle: standing perfectly still, arms at his sides, blank face
spectators.cheer: a polite small clap with the tiniest smile
spectators.shocked: bowl cut floating straight up, faint pale-blue psychic glow, eyes still blank

spectators.name: Arataka Reigen
spectators.look: slick self-proclaimed psychic with light ash-blond side-parted hair and a wide confident grin, wearing a light-gray business suit with a white shirt and a thin tie, holding a small bag of salt
spectators.fallbackLook: slick confident man with light ash-blond side-parted hair and a wide salesman grin in a light-gray business suit, white shirt and thin tie, holding a small bag of salt
spectators.idle: hands in pockets, smooth salesman grin
spectators.cheer: flinging a handful of white salt in a wide arc, shouting
spectators.shocked: sweating buckets, grin frozen, tie flipped over his shoulder

spectators.name: Dimple
spectators.look: small floating green ghost spirit shaped like a teardrop blob with a wispy tail instead of legs, tiny black eyes, a smug mouth and round rosy-red cheek spots
spectators.fallbackLook: small floating green teardrop-shaped ghost spirit with a wispy tail instead of legs, tiny black eyes, a smug mouth and round rosy-red cheek spots
spectators.idle: hovering with a smug smirk, tiny nub arms crossed
spectators.cheer: swelling bigger and glowing brighter green, cackling
spectators.shocked: shrinking small, eyes popping, tail curling

spectators.name: Ritsu Kageyama
spectators.look: composed middle-school boy with neat black hair swept to one side and sharp narrow dark eyes, wearing a white short-sleeve summer school shirt, black trousers, black shoes and a red student-council armband on his left sleeve
spectators.fallbackLook: composed short schoolboy with neat black hair swept to one side and sharp narrow eyes in a white short-sleeve school shirt, black trousers and a red armband on his left sleeve
spectators.idle: arms crossed, cool expression with a hint of worry
spectators.cheer: small pebbles floating around his raised hand, rare grin
spectators.shocked: eyes wide, hands up, pebbles scattering through the air

spectators.name: Teruki Hanazawa (Teru)
spectators.look: cocky middle-school boy with golden-blond hair swept up and back, bright confident eyes and a smirk, wearing an open black high-collar school jacket over a white T-shirt, black trousers and white sneakers
spectators.fallbackLook: cocky short schoolboy with golden-blond hair swept up and back and a smirk in an open black high-collar school jacket over a white T-shirt, black trousers and white sneakers
spectators.idle: hands in pockets, knowing smile, a sparkle at his collar
spectators.cheer: pointing at the ring, golden psychic shimmer around his hand
spectators.shocked: hands on his head, hair suddenly flopped messy, eyes wide

spectators.name: Musashi Goda
spectators.look: giant muscle-packed high-school bodybuilder with short spiky dark-brown hair, thick dark eyebrows and a gentle wide smile, wearing a black sleeveless gym shirt, baggy gray sweatpants, white sneakers and a white towel around his neck
spectators.fallbackLook: giant muscle-packed teenage bodybuilder with short spiky dark-brown hair, thick eyebrows and a gentle smile in a black sleeveless gym shirt, baggy gray sweatpants and a white towel around his neck
spectators.idle: polite nod, hands resting on the towel ends, relaxed
spectators.cheer: double-biceps flex with arms out to the sides, beaming
spectators.shocked: muscles tensed, gentle eyes wide, towel flying off

spectators.name: Katsuya Serizawa

spectators.fallbackLook: tall shy man with messy wavy black hair, light stubble and nervous droopy eyes in a rumpled navy-blue suit, white shirt and dark tie, a closed black umbrella hooked over his arm

spectators.cheer: open umbrella held out to the side and spinning, shy cheer
spectators.shocked: ducking behind his open umbrella, sweating

spectators.fallbackLook: cheerful short schoolgirl with shoulder-length light-brown hair, side bangs and bright brown eyes in a navy sailor-style school uniform with a white-striped collar, red neckerchief, navy pleated skirt and white socks
